visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with blue-grey hair and a grey MARD sweatshirt stands in a clean, modern white-tiled kitchen. (2) She turns away and walks toward a large, silver Panasonic refrigerator, opening the door to reveal several organized food items inside. She pulls out a clear plastic bottle containing a small amount of dark liquid, showing it to be nearly empty. (3) A man in a black long-sleeve shirt enters the kitchen holding a brown cardboard Costco box. He stands near a kitchen island and opens the top flaps to reveal a large, new bottle of Japanese BBQ sauce, presenting it with a helpful smile. (4) The woman smiles broadly and takes the bottle from him. The two embrace in a hug in the center of the kitchen, with the open cardboard box and the new sauce bottle clearly visible in their hands. (5) The woman kneels down to open a sliding lower cabinet drawer filled with various condiment bottles. She pulls out another bottle identical to the new one, looking surprised as she examines its labels in the well-lit kitchen environment. (6) A sharp close-up shot focuses on the back label of the sauce bottle. A finger points specifically to the printed expiration date 2023.06.07, clearly indicating that the item is long past its recommended use-by date. (7) The woman stands up with a frustrated and annoyed facial expression, holding the expired bottle. The man stands next to her, looking directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, comical expression of shock and bewilderment. (8) The scene shifts to a living room where a young child wearing white pajamas is rolling around on a grey fabric L-shaped sofa. The child is laughing uncontrollably, with a blurred outdoor city view visible through the window behind.
